channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 25
item.description:
65 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Store UI updated to render dynamic fullscreen and gallery sprites, now shows sale price and discount details, inspector includes private serialized fields and layout fixes; added HealthThresholdToggle to HUD for customizable health alerts.

Combat & Weapons

  • Radwater now scales damage with protection instead of flat values, flashlight toggles with right‑click and features new view‑model and third‑person animations, semi‑automatic pistol gains increased damage falloff at range and its high‑quality‑metal craft cost raised from 4 to 6, and weapon body spawn rates were rebalanced (SMG up, Rifle down).

Animals & Livestock

  • Rabbits added with full animation, model, prefab files and standardized naming.
  • New UI panels for selling animals: one lists nearby sellable animals, the other previews rewards (functionality pending).

Vehicles & Armour

  • HAB vehicle armour colliders fixed for client/server removal and frame collision mesh added; attack helicopter armour damage system updated with proper collider/visual toggle groups and unique naming; modular car handling improved with reduced body roll, spin‑out prevention and smoother steering for high‑speed drifting.

AI & Navigation

  • Low‑resolution navmesh issue on ghost ships fixed and old AI no longer flees when the player jumps; navmesh test framework dependency removed to avoid build breaks.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Session modal overflow fixed (description scroll works, long texts no longer block disconnect button), comfort rugs now provide 100 % comfort within a 1–2 m radius with gradual falloff, and siren off‑state visibility bug resolved.
  • Store UI updated to render dynamic fullscreen and gallery sprites, now shows sale price and discount details, inspector includes private serialized fields and layout fixes; added HealthThresholdToggle to HUD for customizable health alerts.

Events & Multiplayer

  • Hackable crates correctly flagged and visual fixes applied; cargo ship event now preserves crate despawn state and loot round progress across server restarts, preventing duplicate spawns; SteamFriendsList.Refresh optimized to eliminate large lag spikes when authorizing friends to turrets or other team interactions.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 24
item.description:
68 development commits

Animals

  • Fixed frog animation glitches, corrected sideways skating and movement speed, and added a new water‑seeking 'interested' state where frogs croak and move toward shallow water.
  • Added a drinking water need for livestock, allowing them to hydrate from containers or natural water sources.
  • Enabled Stable B for animal trading, introducing basic NPC conversation and selling mechanics for animals.

Vehicles

  • Added restoreHierarchy flag to pooled vehicles, fixing UI pooling issues for vehicle objects.
  • Improved car handling: fixed handbrake logic, prevented duck toggle lock, applied raw tyre force, refined suspension, steering, grip, and added visual rear‑wheel lock during handbrake.
  • Introduced a configurable setting to adjust the drone detonation distance and updated helicopter passenger seat weapons to apply aim sway scaled by movement speed.

UI & Inventory

  • Various UI stability and visual fixes: health bar now shows when hitting monument blockers, store prop drawer fallback image added, FadeCanvasGroup null‑reference crash prevented, arrow revamp icons corrected, and homing launcher UI now displays 'Keep on target' with lock‑on timer reduced by 30%.
  • Hotbar now allows swapping of overstacks via server‑side RPC, repair bench functionality fixed, and random skin crafting now includes the default skin as a possible outcome.

Gameplay & Balance

  • SAM sites receive new anti‑drone buffs: proximity‑fuse missiles, 2.25× speed lead without aim error, and ability to destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air.
